title: Questions to Ask Before Signing with a New Co-Manufacturer: A Checklist for Growing Brands
summary: Switching co-manufacturers takes time, money, and a lot of trust. Use this checklist to make sure you're asking the right questions.
body_markdown:
[Manufacturing](https://thefreshfactory.co/blog-categories/manufacturing/) ,


[Tips](https://thefreshfactory.co/blog-categories/tips/)


November 25, 2026


Most brands don’t seek out a new co-manufacturer when things are going badly. They start looking because things are going well. Retail doors are opening,[a club buyer](https://thefreshfactory.co/blog/club-channel-distribution/) is interested, and demand is starting to outrun what your current partner can produce. While that’s a good problem to have, it raises the stakes on your next move.


[Switching co-manufacturers](https://thefreshfactory.co/blog/new-co-man/) takes time, money, and a lot of trust. The wrong fit can stall the growth you worked hard to build, and you don’t want to trade one partner that’s too small for another.


If you’ve been through this before, you probably already have a project brief with your specs, volumes, and must-haves. Use the following checklist alongside it. It covers the questions experienced brands ask before they sign, from equipment and capacity to[certifications](https://thefreshfactory.co/certifications/) and formula protection, so you can walk into every conversation knowing exactly what to look for.


Where you start depends on whether you already have a recipe. If you’re developing a new product or need help refining your formula, start with[Product Development](https://thefreshfactory.co/food-development/) . If you already have a production-ready formula, skip ahead to Formula Handoff.


## Co-Manufacturer Checklist


[Download this Checklist as a PDF](https://thefreshfactory.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/tff_co-manufacturer_checklist.pdf)


### Product Development


- Can you develop my product from scratch, or refine a concept I’ve already started?
- Does your team have food science expertise in my category?
- Do you have experience with clean-label formulation, like getting the right texture without loading up on starches and gums?
- Will you develop my formula around processes your facility actually runs?
- Are the development terms clear upfront, including whether development is tied to manufacturing with you?
- Can your facility manufacture my product within my required budget?
- Can your facility have development up and running by my deadline?
- Will I own my end recipe?


### Formula Handoff


- Will you sign an NDA before reviewing my formula? (A good partner will insist on it.)
- Will you review my formula for manufacturing feasibility?
- Can I share my current production process and a gold-standard sample for you to match?
- If my formula needs rework for efficiency, will you keep it true to my gold-standard sample?


### Testing and Trials


- Can your lab replicate production conditions on the bench?
- Do I approve bench samples before you move to a production trial?
- Does your lab mirror your production lines closely enough that bench formulas scale with minimal adjustment?
- Do I get final approval on ingredient or spec changes?
- Do you manage process authority reviews and challenge studies?


### Production Capabilities


- Can you process my product in its current format?
- Do you have the equipment my process requires (mixers, extruders, fillers, lidding and capping) or comparable equipment that produces the same result?
- Can your packaging lines run my exact container, closure, and fill size?
- Can you meet my labeling requirements?
- Can you replicate my full production process, from batching through packaging?
- Will my product look the same on the shelf?


### Capacity and Scalability


- Can you handle my current volume comfortably?
- Could you handle double that volume?
- Can you ramp up quickly when a new retailer or promotion comes through?
- Can you produce club sizes and configurations?
- Do you have the flex capacity to support rotational club programs without shorting your existing business?
- Do you have a clear plan for scheduling production when demand spikes?


### Food Safety and Quality


- Do you hold an SQF Food Safety certification?
- Do you have a Food Safety audit score of 90 or higher?
- Do you hold an SQF Quality certification?
- Can you maintain every claim on my packaging (organic, Non-GMO Project Verified, kosher, gluten-free)?
- Can my quality team (or a third-party auditor) audit your facility before we sign?
- Do you have documented ingredient traceability and testing programs?


### Pricing and Partnership


- Does your pricing work at my current volume and as I grow?
- Can you help source ingredients?
- Do you have experience with brands in my category?
- Do you have processes in place to grow with me over the next several years?


## Find a Partner Built for Your Next Stage


The right co-manufacturer should be able to answer every question on this list with confidence and show you the runway to grow.
